Ana: Heads-up, p99 for MoE inference on 8xA100 just jumped ~18% after yesterday's kernel-selector change. Repro: small-batch chat workload with token routing pattern (short prefixes, variable expert fanout).
Mike: ugh, when did this land?
Ana: rolled at 02:10 UTC by the runtime rollout. Change: prefer the new fused all-reduce+scatter kernel for >2 GPUs to reduce latency for large seqs.
Sasha: but our MoE all-to-all has a lot of tiny messages, not large seqs. Could be causing fragmentation/queueing in NCCL.
Ana: exact. profiler shows long NCCL Wait events while GPUs idle, then big bursts. timeline attached to perf-bot: https://perf.internal/trace/1782003333 (sample)
perf-bot: Trace summary: avg token latency +12%, p99 +18%. NCCL wait time increased by 2.7x for all-to-all phase. GPU SM utilization drops ~20% in routing micro-window.
Lee: can you paste the nvprof/nsight command you ran?
Ana: ran nvprof + nvtx markers around routing. snippet:```bash
nsys profile -o /tmp/run.nsys --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi 
  --trace=cuda,nvtx --sample=none --backtrace=auto -- 
  ./serve --model moe_xl --batching=dynamic````
Ana: timeline snippet (simplified):
```
GPU0: compute  |--| idle ----|--| compute
GPU1: ncclWait  |----| ncclAllToAll |----| idle
```
Sasha: hypothesis: fused kernel increases launch latency for many small ranks, so we end up with serialized launches and NCCL stalls. Also NVLink contention due to non-overlapped small all-to-all windows.
Eva: any config knobs we can flip quickly? fallback to old kernel? disable fused path?
Ana: yes, revert patch or add heuristic: only use fused kernel when per-rank message bytes > 64KB OR seq_len > 1024. Current selector used total model size heuristics only.
Mike: can we test a canary? I can patch selector to use per-message byte threshold and run overnight regression suite.
ops: tagging perf oncall @Lee and infra @infra-bot for GPU queue visibility.
infra-bot: infra note: we saw increased NCCL retries on the 8xA100 cluster at 02:11 UTC correlating with rollout. No hard OOMs.
Sasha: small experiment ideas: 1) force old allreduce kernel + original scatter 2) add 64KB cutoff 3) run synthetic MoE microbenchmark that mimics our routing skew distribution.
Ana: I ran (3) locally, skewed routing with 90/10 split and small per-token payloads — reproduced 15% p99 regression. Will push microbenchmark to repo: git@repo:moe/microbench/route_stall_test.
Mike: I'll prepare a rollback PR if the canary confirms. If we revert, we should add selector unit tests that include MoE small-message profiles.
Eva: add an automated perf guard: when rollout increases p99 by >5% on MoE flagged tests, block rollout.
Ana: agree. Action items: (Ana) upload full nsight trace + nvprof log; (Mike) patch selector with cutoff + run canary; (Sasha) add microbench harness and mocha test; (Lee) watch infra NCCL metrics during canary.
ops: will schedule a maintenance window if we need rollback on prod.
Mike: starting canary now on a single reserved pool (8xA100). ETA 45m. Will post results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Ana: thanks — feel free to ping me in thread for logs. :thumbsup:
